row.name: Automatic Data Processing Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=18 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.39 tightness=0.77 base_volume_vs_leg=0.93 base_volume_vs_avg=0.99
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: the base gave back 0.39 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close -3.4% vs its 20-SMA, -8.5% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The base spanning September 2 through September 28 is visibly a declining consolidation: price drifted steadily lower from ~288 to ~260, with the 20-day and 50-day moving averages both rolling over and pointing down through the shaded region, confirming the measured giveback of 0.39 (well above the 0.34 threshold). The burst bar itself is narrow (range expansion only 0.56 of the prior 5 bars, a recorded FAIL on RE), and the signal day's close-change of 0.0% with a gap-down open of -0.8% means the entire dollar move came from an intraday recovery off a lower open — not a genuine expansion out of a tight base. Two recorded FAILs (C and RE) and a visibly declining base make this a marginal setup at best.
claude.key_risk: The base is a downtrend, not a consolidation, and the burst bar lacks range expansion, so any follow-through is likely to be absorbed by overhead supply from the prior highs near 285–290.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 261.8 or if the first 30 minutes show no ability to hold above 262 with expanding volume.
